name: work-ledger
description: Read-only pane showing pending and at-risk work from the work-ledger out/ledger.json, and the retomar skill to resume a project with context rebuilt from the ledger, git and transcripts.

ledgerPath.title: Ledger path
ledgerPath.description: ledger.json file the pane reads. A leading ~ is your home dir.

projectRoot.title: Project root
projectRoot.description: Working directory of the work_ledger refresh command. A leading ~ is your home dir.

pythonCommand.title: Python command
pythonCommand.description: Python executable used to run the refresh.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the ledger pane when a session starts.

piecesDir.title: Pieces inbox
piecesDir.description: Curation inbox folder; the newest YYYY-MM-DD folder in it is shown.

colorScheme.title: Color scheme
colorScheme.description: Pick light or dark to match the app theme; auto uses colors that work on both.
